text:
Robin (partnerships): Heads-up 12 Titan Hardware PO to AWS marketplace failed price validation. Customer launch tomorrow, seats blocked. :grimacing:
Sam (deal-desk): Oof. Paste the portal rejection and the PO line item snippet?
Robin (partnerships): Portal response:
```
<error code=\"PO_VALIDATION\">price_mismatch</error>
```
PO line snippet:
```
<Line sku=\"TIT-VM-XL-PROMO\">
  <Qty>200</Qty>
  <UnitPrice currency=\"USD\">45.00</UnitPrice>
</Line>
```
Alex (finance): Marketplace enforces catalog price for SKU. If PO price != catalog price, it's rejected. We need either a signed commercial exception or proof that promo SKU maps to a different catalog SKU with that price.
Maya (vendor-success): Titan claims this was a time-limited promotional price tied to a signed quote (quote #Q-8872). They emailed a PDF quote signed by their sales director. Marketplace won't accept manual price drops without partner admin approval.
Lee (eng-integrations): Short-term tech mitigation: add header X-Price-Override-Quote: <quote-hash> and X-Original-PO to the outbound payload. That surface allows partner ops to see provenance. Also we can map SKU alias TIT-VM-XL-PROMO -> TIT-VM-XL in gateway so catalog price check passes if we apply override. Estimated prototype: 24-48h for alias mapping + header support.
Priya (legal): Any price override must be backed by a commercial approval doc and include an audit trail. I'll prepare a one-page price-override acknowledgement for Titan to sign that records the quote hash and indemnity for pricing discrepancies.
Nina (product): Question: is TIT-VM-XL-PROMO actually a separate SKU in Titan's marketplace catalog? If yes, the catalog price may be different. If it's an alias they used internally we can map. Need to check catalogue metadata.
MarketplaceBot: "AW-51290 created: PO rejected (price_mismatch). Partner review SLA 48h."
Sam (deal-desk): Recommended two-track plan: 1) Immediate: request marketplace admin exception attaching the signed quote + quote hash and ask for expedited review; 2) Parallel: engineering implement alias mapping + X-Quote-Hash header and legal to get Titan to sign the acknowledgement.
Maya (vendor-success): Uploading signed quote to case AW-51290 and asking Titan to confirm billing entity is unchanged. They've replied: billingEntity remains TIT-NA, no change.
Alex (finance): Finance note: need to confirm revenue recognition and whether reseller discount passes through. If Titan's price falls below our minimum margin, we need commercial sign-off.
Priya (legal): Draft v0 of price-override acknowledgement ready. Key clause: "Seller confirms signed quote Q-8872 authorizes Redwood to submit price override to marketplace; Redwood will preserve original PO and the signed quote in audit logs." Will DM for review.
Lee (eng-integrations): I'll open branch hotfix/sku-alias-price-override and add tests for alias mapping and headers. Will aim for staging deploy in ~36h.
Robin (partnerships): Action items: Maya -> confirm quote uploaded and billingEntity (done); Sam -> chase marketplace admin for exception; Priya -> finalize acknowledgement and get Titan sign-off; Lee -> start alias mapping PR; Alex -> confirm finance margin/reg-rec. Target: manual exception today, engineering fix next sprint.
MarketplaceBot: "AW-51290 status: escalated -> partner admin review. ETA update in ~6h."
